summary_md: **laxshmate ([@laxshmate](https://x.com/laxshmate/status/2115775665563697555))** introduces **genmodelfit**, which reads your GPU and memory and tells you whether image, video, audio and 3D generation models will run locally (`uvx genmodelfit recommend`) ([laxshmate/genmodelfit](https://github.com/laxshmate/genmodelfit)).
